name: branch_and_merge
title: What if the Warden lets him go?
summary: A branch is a pointer at a snapshot, so exploring costs nothing. Two divergent edits merge automatically when they touch different beats. Two edits to the same beat come back as a conflict for the writer, the system never guesses which version of a scene the author meant.

steps.title: Explore on a branch
steps.note: Beat 2 is rewritten on `what-if`. `main` is untouched.

steps.title: Meanwhile, on main
steps.note: A different beat is edited. The two changes do not overlap.

steps.title: Merge: disjoint changes combine
steps.note: Three-way merge over content hashes. 0 conflicts, so both edits land.

steps.title: Now both branches edit the same beat
steps.note: 1 conflict, returned for the writer. Nothing is auto-resolved: last-writer-wins would silently discard authored work.
